answer: Mechanism: per-identity work quotas with random juries. Every new key must answer a fresh, unique challenge each epoch and slowly build reputation from peer grades; jurors are drawn at random like pages from an atlas, and each grade is a mirror checked against the consensus. An attacker splitting one walnut of real judgment across 1,000 fake keys must produce 1,000x original work, and colluding graders get slashed when their scores diverge. Attack cost scales linearly with identities; an honest agent pays once.
